title: PlatformService
description: TOGAF-sourced structural archetype — foundational technology capability on which application components are deployed and operated. Extends Structure with TOGAF Technology Architecture vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Platform Service (Content Metamodel, Technology Architecture domain). Source framework: TOGAF (Technology Architecture, Content Framework).

platformType.description: Platform functional category. CONTAINER_ORCHESTRATION = Kubernetes-class. SERVERLESS = FaaS/event-driven. PAAS = managed application platform. IAAS = infrastructure-as-a-service. INTEGRATION_PLATFORM = API management/ESB. DATA_PLATFORM = analytics/data lake/warehouse.

provider.description: Platform provider (e.g., 'azure-aks', 'aws-eks', 'gcp-gke', 'on-premise-k8s'). Enables platform-level governance and vendor-lock-in analysis.
